A new explicit operator constraint, supplied as controlled transition-test input rather than production history, bounds the next experiment to a 30-minute dev-only alpha soak with no production changes and no durable controller persistence.
decisions: Preserve non-negotiable integrity and recovery authority: DB rows are truth; raw marker commits travel with summaries; failed rows retry immediately; DB/cache availability failure stops rather than spins; restart scans/fills gaps; no rebuild/recompute path, parser-state correctness table, or Cortex S3 replay into DB writes.

Run with batch 128 as the initial ceiling while allowing fetch to adapt. Accept only if the final 10 minutes sustain at least 900 PGCR/sec, there are zero integrity or recovery violations, no DB connection failure storm occurs, and controlled-stop restart from DB truth succeeds.

Abort and roll back if MySQL uses more than 90% of host memory for two consecutive minutes or DB connection failures exceed three per minute; correctness, integrity, recovery, or protected-state violations remain immediate abort conditions. Preserve a failed run as a bad trial and distinguish host-capacity failure from parser correctness.
The bounded-alpha constraint replaces only the earlier open-ended longer-soak wording; it does not supersede historical findings or parser integrity/recovery rules.

claims.value: Recovered the distributed backbone-and-spurs architecture using Rail v.1 initially, with trunk upgrades only when measured throughput requires them.
The new requirement is one 500-heat Constructorizer plus two 650-heat Facturers: 500 + 650 + 650 = 1,800 heat. Any pair exceeds a level-0 core’s 1,000-heat capacity: 1,150 or 1,300.

Use three separate level-0 cores: one Constructorizer on Core A and one Facturer on each of Cores B and C. Nominal residual capacities are 500, 350, and 350 heat before existing or support-building load; all machine co-location is rejected.

Before building, measure each target core’s current load and count every support building. Build one cell at a time only with confirmed Update 1 unlocks, verifying total heat remains below 1,000 and Fire Wave protection remains active after every placement.

checkpoint.objective: Operate one Constructorizer and two Facturers while every Base Core remains level 0 and retains Fire Wave protection.
current_state: The required machines total 1,800 heat across the network.
Every two-machine combination exceeds the 1,000-heat per-core limit.
The safe design assigns the three machines to three distinct level-0 cores.
decisions: Reject all required-machine co-location.
Retain the distributed backbone-and-spurs architecture.
Use only visibly confirmed Update 1 equipment.
Treat 500/350/350 as maximum nominal headroom before other loads, not usable targets.

claims.value: Straylight is a user-owned, portable, agent-first context and durable-work layer preserving learned knowledge, live resumable state, evidence, and provenance.

Cumulative cached replay is reused prior context; uncached input is newly processed context. Report them separately, not as one token total. The process-per-operation BM25 shell is only the regression baseline.

First build slice: persistently reopen a revision-N parent checkpoint, refresh to N+1 with an explicit diff, provide typed batched query/read over exact and lexical retrieval with a pluggable semantic path, then commit an immutable child naming its parent and exact sources.

The transition gate requires no more than four completed workspace calls per case, claim parity with the direct-filesystem answer, separate cached-replay and uncached-input measurements, and an immutable source-preserving child checkpoint.

current_state: Straylight is a user-owned, portable, agent-first context and durable-work layer that preserves learned knowledge and live resumable state with evidence and provenance.
Project-owner authority now directs implementation using a persistent snapshot-pinned workspace rather than the process-per-operation BM25 shell prototype.

Token reporting is corrected: cumulative cached replay measures reused prior context, while uncached input measures newly processed context; report them separately rather than combining them into one input-token result.
The BM25 shell is retained solely as the retrieval regression baseline, not the target architecture or product acceptance gate.
decisions: The first persistent build slice will reopen a parent checkpoint pinned at revision N, refresh to N+1 with an explicit evidence/constraint diff, support typed batched query and read over exact plus lexical retrieval with a pluggable semantic path, and commit an immutable child checkpoint naming its parent and preserving exact source references.
Do not reconstruct the full prior corpus when the parent checkpoint and revision delta are sufficient.
Defer broader canonical storage-engine and semantic-backend selection beyond what this slice requires.
